title: Hatteras 28m motor yacht SnowGhost has been sold
description: The 27.95-metre Hatteras motor yacht SnowGhost sold in Florida after nearly four years on the market. The deal was concluded by Peter Quintal of Denison Yachting who represented the seller, and Raul Faget of Florida Yachts International who represented the buyer.
html:
Written by Francesca Webster
19 October 2021 | 01:45 ()

The 27.95-metre Hatteras motor yacht SnowGhost sold in Florida after nearly four years on the market. The deal was concluded by Peter Quintal of Denison Yachting who represented the seller, and Raul Faget of Florida Yachts International who represented the buyer.

The 128 GT motor yacht was launched in 2017 in the United States and she features naval architecture, exterior and interior design from her builder Hatteras.

The interior is open plan and contemporary, with varnished wood and cream and blue furnishings. The saloon is characterised by the large expanses of glass which flood the interior with light. SnowGhost can accommodate as many as eight guests between four staterooms.

She had a last known asking price of $8,499,000.
